items.prompt: Wellesley students actively seek ways to build bridges and to change the world for the better. Tell us about an experience working with and alongside people of different backgrounds and/or perspectives from your own. Why was this important to you, and what lessons from this will you bring with you to Wellesley?
items.ru: Дополнительное эссе Wellesley: про опыт работы вместе с людьми другого происхождения или взглядов и чему он научил. 250–400 слов.
items.evidence: For the Wellesley-specific essay we ask you to respond to the following prompt in 250 to 400 words:

items.ru: Две рекомендации от преподавателей; хотя бы одна — с оценкой уровня английского: чтение, письмо, речь.
items.evidence: Wellesley requires two letters of recommendation from academic instructors. At least one recommendation must include an evaluation of your proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English.

items.ru: Школьный консультант отправляет School Report с последними оценками через Common App или Coalition.
items.evidence: Your school counselor should submit your transcript(s) through the Common Application or the Coalition Application. Your counselor must also complete and submit the School Report (with your most recent grades).

items.ru: Если английский не родной и учились на нём меньше 4 лет, советуют тест или интервью InitialView/Vericant.
items.evidence: If English is not your native language and you have been studying in an English-based curriculum for fewer than four years, we strongly recommend that you take one of the following English-proficiency tests or use one of the interview tools: TOEFL (iBT or Essentials) Duolingo English Test IELTS Cambridge Assessment English Qualifications (C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency, or C1 Business Higher accepted) InitialView Vericant (Standard Interview, which includes a writing sample) GTEC CBT (Global Test of English Communication Computer Based Testing)

items.ru: Необязательное портфолио по искусству, музыке или театру, если есть особый талант в этих областях.
items.evidence: Visual arts, music, and theatre portfolios (optional) If you have a special talent in the arts, you might want to submit an Arts Portfolio

items.ru: Если хочешь выступать в спортивной команде Wellesley (Division III), отправь recruiting form тренеру.
items.evidence: If you are interested in competing in varsity athletics at Wellesley (Division III), submit a recruiting form to the head coach of your sport.
